question: How long is the standard warranty on a new Nimbus device?
reference: Every new Nimbus device includes a one-year limited warranty starting on the original date of purchase.
contexts: # Nimbus Limited Warranty Every new Nimbus device (Nimbus Phone X2, Nimbus Watch S, Nimbus Buds Pro, and Nimbus Laptop Air) includes a one-year limited warranty starting on the original date of purchase. The warranty covers manufacturing defects in materials and workmanship, including faulty buttons, dead pixels on the display, and batteries that fail to hold a charge due to a defect. The limited warranty does not cover accidental damage such as cracked screens, liquid damage, cosmetic scratches, or damage caused by third-party accessories. It also does not cover devices that have been opened or repaired by an unauthorized service provider. To make a warranty claim, customers need the device serial number and proof of purchase. Warranty repairs are free of charge. If a device cannot be repaired, Nimbus will replace it with a new or refurbished device of equivalent functionality. Replacement devices are covered for the remainder of the original warranty or 90 days, whichever is longer.

# NimbusCare+ Protection Plan NimbusCare+ is an optional protection plan that extends coverage to two years from the date of purchase for phones, watches, and earbuds, and to three years for the Nimbus Laptop Air. It must be purchased within 60 days of buying the device. NimbusCare+ adds coverage for up to two incidents of accidental damage every 12 months. Each accidental damage incident is subject to a service fee: $29 for screen-only damage on the Nimbus Phone X2 and $99 for other accidental damage on the phone. For the Nimbus Laptop Air, the service fee is $99 for screen damage and $299 for other damage. NimbusCare+ also includes priority 24/7 phone support and express replacement shipping. NimbusCare+ costs $149 for the Nimbus Phone X2, $79 for the Nimbus Watch S, $29 for Nimbus Buds Pro, and $249 for the Nimbus Laptop Air. NimbusCare+ can be cancelled at any time for a prorated refund. NimbusCare+ does not cover loss or theft.

# Your Privacy During Repairs Nimbus technicians do not need access to your personal data to perform most repairs. When you send a device for service, you can turn on Repair Mode, which keeps your data encrypted and locked while still allowing the technician to run diagnostics. Repair Mode is available on Nimbus Phone X2 and Nimbus Laptop Air running NimbusOS 5.2 or later. If Repair Mode is not available, Nimbus recommends backing up and erasing your device before service. Nimbus never asks for your Nimbus Account password during a repair, and technicians are prohibited from viewing photos, messages, or other personal content. Diagnostic logs collected during service contain hardware information only and are deleted 90 days after the repair is complete. Repair records, including the device serial number and repair description, are kept for 3 years for warranty purposes.

Move the device to a cooler place out of direct sunlight and remove any thick case. If a Nimbus Laptop Air feels hot, make sure it is on a hard, flat surface, quit apps that are using a lot of processing power in Activity Monitor, and update to the latest version of NimbusOS. If the device repeatedly shows a temperature warning in normal room conditions, run Nimbus Diagnostics and contact Nimbus Support. Do not place devices in a refrigerator or freezer to cool them down.

On a Nimbus Laptop Air, shut down the laptop, then press and hold the power button until you see "Loading startup options," and press Command-D. Diagnostics takes 2 to 5 minutes. When complete, you'll see a reference code; codes starting with "PPT" indicate a battery issue, and codes starting with "NDC" indicate a wireless connectivity issue. Share the reference code with Nimbus Support. Diagnostics does not collect personal data.
